title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
question: How do you serialize a binary tree to a string and deserialize it back (LeetCode 297)?
realWorldScenario: Preorder traversal with null markers ('X') for serialization; reconstruct by consuming the preorder sequence.

title: Path Sum All Paths
question: How do you find all root-to-leaf paths that sum to a target (LeetCode 113)?
searchIntent: all paths sum to target java interview
realWorldScenario: DFS with backtracking — add node to path, recurse, then remove (backtrack). Add path to result at leaf when target hit.

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
question: How do you find the maximum path sum in a binary tree (path can start and end anywhere)?
seoKeywords: max path sum binary tree java
searchIntent: maximum path sum binary tree java interview
realWorldScenario: At each node, max gain downward = node.val + max(leftGain, rightGain, 0). Path through node = node.val + leftGain + rightGain.

title: BST Iterator
question: How do you implement a BST iterator that returns elements in ascending order with O(h) space?
realWorldScenario: Use a stack; push all left children from the current node; next() pops the top, then pushes left children of its right child.

title: Convert Sorted Array to BST
question: How do you convert a sorted array to a height-balanced BST (LeetCode 108)?
searchIntent: sorted array to balanced BST java interview
realWorldScenario: Use the middle element as root recursively to ensure balanced height. O(n) time.

title: Flatten Tree to Linked List
question: How do you flatten a binary tree to a linked list in-place using preorder (LeetCode 114)?
seoKeywords: flatten binary tree linked list java
searchIntent: flatten binary tree linked list java interview
realWorldScenario: For each node: move right subtree to the right of the rightmost left descendant, then make left subtree the new right. O(n).
